title: Before you see the doctor: how an AI assistant can help you prepare, and where to stop

posts.facebook:
Use AI to organise your notes and questions for the doctor. Leave every decision about your health to the doctor.

How to use an AI assistant to prepare for a medical appointment: a short timeline, three priority questions, plain-word explanations of terms you have already been given, and a write-up afterwards. Plus what the WHO and the AI makers themselves say about its limits, and a clear list of what not to ask it.

Let an AI assistant tidy your timeline and sharpen your questions, then take both to a clinician who can examine you.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/ai/using-ai-for-health-questions-before-an-appointment/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
